source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative file LF, sorted over five files_sha256; report/log excluded

provenance.new_code: Original darwin-lab wrapper, staged image construction and host tests; no GPL implementation copied.
provenance.facts: T8020 16KiB pages, table indices25/14 with11bits, canonical TTBR/table image geometry inherited from the original frozen scalar codec. No DART register order was implemented.
provenance.inherited_scope: Codec provenance includes historical Linux numeric cross-checks; its original implementation is not GPL source and is reused unchanged. No GPL file, including pcie-apple.c, was read or copied for this slice.
provenance.license: Original project licensing pending; upstream provenance unchanged.

model.endpoint: Exact synthetic WLAN RID0x100 bus1/dev0/fn0, current fake PCI14e4:4425. Explicit SID0..15 only; fixture SID3 is not an observed physical WLAN stream.
model.limit: One contiguous <=4MiB mapping in one32MiB L1 span; no append, unmap, allocation, reuse or firmware-table adoption.
model.storage: Two caller-owned ordinary16KiB byte arrays plus separate staging workspace. Physical PAs are numerical labels only, never cast to CPU pointers.
model.policy: Explicit stable RAM/reservation ranges; codec validates alignment/overflow, canonical reserved bits, table references, R/W, PA aliases and table/data/reservation conflicts before output commit.
model.publication: Software image and two ordinary RAM copies only. No DART TTBR/TCR register, invalidation or cache maintenance is simulated as a genuine acknowledgement.
model.fake_PHY: Immutable fixture value0x80 (reset asserted). Independent synthetic LINK_UP is deliberately not an electrically consistent hardware simulation and grants no real MMIO permission.

entry_contract.init: Validates exact requester/stream bounds, storage geometry and numeric encodings; checks current fake link/PCI before recording metadata. Full RAM/reservation/image validation occurs during map.
entry_contract.map: Fresh link/PCI first; stage and validate whole image; second link check before both output-page copies. Caller serialization excludes asynchronous fake mutations during CPU commit.
entry_contract.translation: Fresh link/PCI and exact RID/SID check each call, then canonical software lookup with permissions. Output PA preserved on failure; no output-table writes.
entry_contract.down_link: RUN0, noUP, BUSY orL2 refuses init/map/lookup with zero table commit and zero register writes. Entry-down leaves workspace unchanged too. Late loss may change inactive staging but never commits output tables.
entry_contract.faults: Fake read error latches fault on a bound map; no silent retry. Validation failure leaves committed file unchanged. No real backing release/quiescence claim.
entry_contract.default_and_kernel: Every API returns BFD_GATED with zero I/O and zero buffer changes. KERNEL+BFD_FAKE_DEVICE and shared-write escape macro are compile-refused. Working fake mode also requires checked host accessor.
entry_contract.caller_lifetime: Map/accessor/policy/storage/workspace/outputs stable, serialized and nonaliasing. Context provenance is a C contract, not an arbitrary-code sandbox.
